business_review.notes: Copy control on /settings/profile announces; path unchanged and not regressed
NavigationProfile panel is div[role=dialog][aria-modal=true] portalled to body; MODAL_SELECTOR matches, container moves in before the copy button is reachable
Reporter confirmed announcement with a screen reader on the rebuilt local stack (2026-09-01); CDP AX-tree capture is supporting evidence

Coverage is structural: every Notes-list surface funnels into utils/toaster.ts and one registered announcer; both copyToClipboard copies (helpers.ts:144, utils.ts:119) end in toaster; PrimeReact Popup passes modal -> aria-modal, so modal-hosted toasts match too
NavigationProfile aria-hidden lifecycle and CR-001/CR-002 assertions untouched; diff is limited to ToasterAnnouncer and its test file

standards_review.notes: Branch EPMCDME-8584_announcer-outside-app-root and both commit subjects carry the ticket key
typecheck and eslint clean; licence header preserved; no new dependency
No untrusted HTML sink, redirect, secret or config surface touched; announcement text is plain textContent
See CR-001 — leaked DOM nodes make one new test vacuous

findings.problem: The new tests append nodes to document.body (an #app div with aria-hidden, and an aria-modal dialog) and never remove them. Testing Library's cleanup only unmounts containers it created, so the stale aria-modal node from the second test is still present during the third.
findings.impact: 'returns the live region to the body once the modal closes' passes vacuously: the container is re-parented into the leftover dialog, yet both assertions still hold because that dialog is itself inside body. The test would stay green if the fallback-to-body logic were deleted.
findings.recommendation: Remove the appended nodes in afterEach, and assert the concrete fallback host (container's parent is document.body) rather than mere containment.

findings.problem: MODAL_SELECTOR matches on attributes alone and 'topmost' is decided by document order. A dialog kept in the DOM while hidden (PrimeReact's ~100-150ms leave transition, or any host retaining an aria-modal node), an inert or aria-hidden dialog, and non-dialog widgets that emit aria-modal (PrimeReact Calendar/Galleria) all capture the region.
findings.impact: The region can park inside a hidden or non-active host, in which case every toast in the app goes silent — a wider regression than the bug being fixed, and invisible to the current tests.
findings.recommendation: Require a dialog/alertdialog role together with aria-modal (or a native dialog[open]), skip candidates that are not visible, are inert, or sit under aria-hidden, and prefer the candidate containing document.activeElement over last-in-document-order.

findings.problem: Placement is not sequenced against the announcement queue. useAnnouncementQueue writes '' and then the text one animation frame later; a toast raised by the same interaction that opens or closes a modal is written into a region that was just re-parented.
findings.impact: Confirm-then-toast flows named in the ticket — Delete All Conversations, Delete in Data Sources — can stay silent, reproducing the partial-fix pattern that caused the reopen.
findings.recommendation: After an actual re-parent, re-emit the current announcement so the content change happens strictly after the move.

findings.problem: The observer watches childList+subtree on document.body and runs a whole-document querySelectorAll for every mutation batch, including the batches its own region produces. This app streams chat tokens and re-renders markdown continuously.
findings.impact: A full-document attribute-selector query on the hottest rendering path, for a placement that changes only when a modal opens or closes.
findings.recommendation: Inspect the MutationRecords first and bail unless a record could plausibly concern a modal; ignore records originating inside the announcer's own container.

rationale: Three lenses ran (blind, edge-case, acceptance); none failed. Acceptance confirms all five criteria including the Notes list, which is covered structurally because every toast funnels through utils/toaster.ts. Four blocking findings survive triage, all bucketed patch: one confirmed test defect (CR-001, high confidence, verified against the test file) and three robustness gaps in the placement logic that all three lenses raised independently (CR-002, CR-003, CR-004). Deferred, not emitted: give the injected container an identifying attribute and take it out of host layout (display:contents) to avoid a latent flex/gap regression in future modals; de-duplicate copyToClipboard across utils/helpers.ts and utils/utils.ts. Dismissed (4): SSR-safety of document.createElement during render (Vite SPA, no SSR path), multiple concurrent announcer instances (single mount point in main.tsx, and the registration slot already guards stale unmounts), StrictMode double-mount (container identity outlives the effect by construction), and modal libraries aria-hiding body siblings (measured not to occur — the body-level region reported ignored:false with the PrimeReact tour dialog open).
